title: Staff
description: A member of the office. The admin panel's identity. The live doc, not the token, is the authority on what they may do.
x-reads: adminpanel: within the live staff scope

authUid.description: The Firebase Auth uid. Links this doc to the email account that signs in.

wardIds.description: The live ward scope. The TOKEN's wardIds is a snapshot of this. This doc is the truth.

phone.description: The raw phone. The admin panel reads it. It is NOT exposed to the driver app or the user app.

active.description: THE INSTANT-REVOCATION SWITCH. Setting this to false locks the staff member out immediately, even with a valid token, because every admin write goes through a callable that reads this doc. Q5.
